fusions.name: The Long Drive
fusions.desc: Drives team and wagon through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 28 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Horns First
fusions.desc: Gores the target with the full load behind the horns. The shunt deals 16 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hitch and Haul
fusions.desc: Hitches up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Yoked Ox
fusions.desc: A bonded draught ox walks in your traces and fights beside you, striking for 5 damage every 2 seconds. You can ride it.
